The '''United Kingdoms of Belcanto''' were the pre-conquest Belcantese political order that preceded Vesperan annexation. Source material describes the polity through several overlapping labels, including united kingdoms, federation, and Belcantese kingdoms.

== Structure ==

The United Kingdoms balanced regional autonomy with collective defense and foreign policy. The [[Council of Seven Crowns]] coordinated major decisions, while local rulers and regional institutions preserved distinctive dialects, economic roles, and cultural traditions.

The exact relationship between the source's five named nations and its seven-crown or seven-region language remains unresolved. This draft uses United Kingdoms of Belcanto as the pre-conquest umbrella page without deciding the final seat count.

== Culture And Language ==

Belcantese unity rested partly on language and music. The [[Belcantese Language]], the [[Council of Tongues]], the [[Great Conservatory of Belcanto]], and regional song traditions helped connect forest, coastal, agricultural, mining, and military communities.

== Fall ==

The [[Belcantese-Northern Alliance Treaty of 1891]] heightened Vesperan concern about Belcanto's foreign alignment. The [[Belcanto Campaign]] began in 1892 and ended organized Belcantese independence by 1895.

After conquest, the [[Vesperan Empire]] dissolved the older political order and replaced it with imperial administration. Belcantese federal ideas later returned during the formation of the postwar [[Belcanto Nations]].
